translations.answer: Cannot. The original maintainer requested alignment of the drive, but subsequent analysis, based on results from approximately two thousand steps prior, suggested it was not a simple drive issue. The current approach should prioritize checking the host drive, the course/condition triggers in the vicinity of this step, and custom terrain representation, while preserving the PVD log. The original post has not yet provided a final root cause.
translations.applicability: Applicable to training that involves a rich variety of cross-machine contact; cannot be generalized to all Isaac Lab training that is not reproducible.
translations.credibility.rationale: The solution has not closed or shown conflict; the issue is still forming a problem trace.
translations.details.attempts.0: The author compared the default plane, built-in terrain, and custom USD, and recorded the PVD from the first 100 iterations.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Aligned the host drive, compared random seed distributions, and checked for course/condition triggers in the vicinity of approximately two thousand steps; the PVD log was preserved.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Lab 2.1, Isaac Sim 4.5, RTX 4090, whole_body_tracking, custom USD terrain.
translations.details.limits.0: This issue cannot prove that the drive version or custom terrain is the root cause; it can only indicate variables to be checked.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The maintainer is still investigating; no final fix has been verified.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: The same code, container, and GPU model produced qualitatively different human training results on two machines.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Do not rely on a single training curve to assess deployment reliability; compare multiple statistical measures and final task metrics.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Custom terrain representation may alter contact modeling or contact resolution, but the root cause has not been confirmed.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Local training can learn the mimic, but the cloud robot cannot stand; the default plane and built-in terrain generator do not trigger.
translations.media_summaries.0: The training curve comparison for this issue is used to show the divergence after two thousand steps; the current round did not perform pixel-wise coordinate reading, and the time point judgment comes from the maintainer's textual analysis of the divergence in the vicinity of two thousand steps.
translations.source.title: Training on the same RTX 4090 and custom USD terrain in the container is not reproducible.
translations.terms.2: Physics Visual Debugger (PVD) (物理可视化调试器)
translations.title: When custom USD terrain causes severe divergence in human training results on two identical GPUs, can we directly attribute it to the drive?
